_extraction_flags.notes: Fiber-based ISAC (F-ISAC). Confirmed by user to include in scope.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Figure 1: Schematic shows 'Tapered FMF' (fiber) and 'SC Laser'/'OSA'. This is clearly a Fiber Sensing setup. Figure 6: BER curves for QPSK/16QAM/64QAM reaching 128 Gbit/s. Figure 4/6: Sensing sensitivity plots (shift in nm vs RI).
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Integrated Fiber Sensing & Comm. Medium: Few-Mode Fiber (FMF). Integration Strategy: Mode Division Multiplexing (MDM) / Spatial Partitioning. LP01 mode used for Sensing (interference dips), LP11 mode used for Comm. This is NOT Wireless/VLC.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 128 Gbps is achieved with 64QAM (verified in Abstract and Section III). Sensing: Sensitivity = 671.25 pm/RIU (Experimental). Salinity sensitivity = 0.1 nm/permille.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: Dual-function FMF where one mode senses environment (salinity) and other carries data. Gap: Shows integration in fiber infrastructure (Smart Cities/Ocean monitoring). Caution: This paper falls under 'Fiber-ISAC', not 'Wireless ISAC'. Check inclusion criteria.

bibliographic.title: Adiabatic-tapered few-mode-fiber-based system for integrating optical fiber sensing and telecommunication
bibliographic.authors: Quandong Huang, Yahao Li, Ou Xu, Xinyong Dong, Sławomir Ertman, Tomasz R. Woliński, Perry Ping Shum, Yuwen Qin

application.scenario_description: Underwater salinity monitoring and high-speed data transmission using a single Few-Mode Fiber.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Demonstration of simultaneous 128 Gbps transmission and salinity sensing using mode-division multiplexing in a tapered few-mode fiber.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Integration of independent sensing and comm systems in fiber networks.

receiver.notes: Coherent receiver for Comm, OSA for Sensing.

waveform.notes: LP01 for Sensing (CW/Interference), LP11 for Comm (QAM).

channel_wireless.notes: 80 km Single Mode Fiber (SMF) + Tapered FMF segment.

comm_metrics.notes: BER limit 3.8e-3 reached at ~17dB SNR for 64QAM.

sensing_metrics.notes: Sensing Salinity/Refractive Index via spectral shift.
